user.title: CARTelemetry
user.description:
Enter the car name exactly as it is set in the Car2Hass Android app (Settings → Car name). The app signs every data payload with this name, so it must match letter for letter.

Third-party apps can also push telemetry via the open API contract — see the developer guide: https://mytechnic.ru/cartelemetry/manual/integration/third-party/

data_description.car_name: Letters, digits, underscore and dash only (no spaces), up to 64 characters

error.invalid_car_name: Use only letters, digits, underscore and dash (no spaces)

abort.already_configured: A vehicle with this name is already configured
